hero.name: Muhammad Pandu Wirakusuma
hero.tagline: Bridging engineering, design, and business strategy to create impactful products.

about: Hi, I am Pandu. I bridge engineering, design, and strategy to create relevant, high-value solutions. With a foundation in electrical and telecommunications engineering, I connect the dots between code, aesthetics, and business needs — whether persuading clients as a sales engineer, crafting experiences as a designer, or leading projects to completion. I believe great ideas need solid systems to make a real impact. Now on my journey toward team management, my focus is leading with empathy, aligning visions, and executing innovation in a measured way.

experience.desc: Teaching undergraduate telecommunication engineering courses (probability & statistics, complex variables, differential equations); developing lesson plans, course contracts, and bilingual materials; mentoring students and advancing applied research in telecommunications and data.

Helped founders grow the business through market-trend innovation and medical equipment marketing strategy. Digital marketing innovation: refreshed product photos for marketplaces. Product development and factory testing (quality, usability, feasibility).

ML forecasting projects: from business problems to models to insights. Student yearbook production from design direction to publication.

projects.desc: A Facebook-like info portal for telecom undergrads: news, updates, resources. Logo and visual identity from concept to final vector with a cohesive visual language. End-to-end user research and usability testing, wireframe and prototype iterations, IA for discoverability.

projects.title: Design Packaging (PT. Mukti Rejo Abadi)

projects.title: NPK Information Website

projects.title: Warehouse Inventory Website (Internal)
projects.desc: A private high-security inventory system. Procurement negotiation and cross-functional collaboration (dev x warehouse). End-to-end MoUs and contracts, governance compliance, bridging legal, finance, and engineering.

Premium UI/UX, technical galleries, vessel features, and booking/inquiry systems. An international-market marketing tool.

research.title: Sentiment Analysis of Digital Banking App Reviews (Internal Research, SDS Lab)

research.title: Deep Learning Prediction of Shallot Prices for Government Policy (MSc Thesis)
